verses.1: And he said, “Listen, heads of Jacob, and officers of the house of Israel: it is necessary for you to know what the judgment is.”
verses.2: Those who hate evil and love good, those who destroy the wicked from their positions, and those who leave them in their own places.
verses.3: And when their other people and foreigners ate from them, they stripped off their clothes and spread out their bodies as it is written in the scriptures: “They spread out their bodies like leaves within a tent.”
verses.4: Then they will cry out to Jehovah, but he will not answer them. He will hide his face from them at that time, when they have sinned against him.
verses.5: So said the LORD about those prophets who deceive My people, who act in both ways. They call for peace, but they do not truly give it. They are made holy by war.
verses.6: So, tonight, you will have darkness and gloominess. But the sun will rise over the prophets, and it will shine upon them that day.
verses.7: And the prophets prophesied, and they searched for the secrets of the universe. They wrote down everything on their lips, for there is no one to answer God’s questions.
verses.8: But I am filled with the spirit of Jehovah’s judgment and power. I will reveal Jacob’s sins, and Israel’s transgressions.
verses.9: Hear this, you leaders of the house of Jacob! And also the officers of the house of Israel, who are tired of judgment and all its injustices.
verses.10: Build Zion in the land of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.11: Their leaders will be punished with death, and their priests will be put to death. Their prophets will be bought with money. May Jehovah save us from these evils, so that He does not come upon us with harm.
verses.12: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be destroyed; Jerusalem will be left in ruins. And the Hill of the House will become a forest.
